    ctx.reg("a", a)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Temporary qubits for carry chain
    c = [ctx.alloc() for _ in range(3)]
    
    # Compute carries using Toffoli gates
    # c[0] = a[0] & b[0]
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c[0])
    
    # c[1] = (a[1] & b[1]) | (a[1] & c[0]) | (b[1] & c[0])
    # Using Toffoli and CNOTs to compute majority
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c[0], c[1])
    ctx.ccx(b[1], c[0], c[1])
    
    # c[2] = majority of a[2], b[2], c[1]
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c[1], c[2])
    ctx.ccx(b[2], c[1], c[2])
    
    # Now compute sum bits using CNOTs and Toffolis
    # s[0] = a[0] ^ b[0]
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])
    # But we need to put result in a[0], so:

    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])  # restore b[0]
    
    # s[1] = a[1] ^ b[1] ^ c[0]
    ctx.cx(a[1], b[1])
    ctx.cx(c[0], b[1])
    ctx.cx(b[1], a[1])
    ctx.cx(a[1], b[1])
    ctx.cx(c[0], b[1])
    
    # s[2] = a[2] ^ b[2] ^ c[1]

    ctx.cx(c[1], b[2])
    ctx.cx(b[2], a[2])
    ctx.cx(a[2], b[2])
    ctx.cx(c[1], b[2])
    
    # Clean up carry chain (reverse computation)
